About Me

I am Alexandra Dela Cruz, a second-year Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student at the University of Mindanao. I am currently building a strong foundation in programming, databases, networking, and web technologies through both coursework and hands-on projects. I have a growing interest in understanding how data can be analyzed and used to support better decision-making, while also developing skills in creating user-friendly interfaces. My goal is to continue improving my technical and analytical abilities and apply them to real-world problems.

Interests and Current Focus:

  • Data analytics and working with data to extract insights
  • Frontend development, focusing on designing and building user interfaces
  • Web technologies and UI design principles
  • Applying programming concepts to practical applications
